sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which specialized agricultural cultivation methodology involves growing organic crops and plants suspended in a nutrient-rich water solution entirely without soil?
What is the primary practical purpose of using a try square tool in basic carpentry and woodworking projects?
options: A) To cut large wooden planks
B) To polish rough bamboo surfaces
C) To check if adjacent edges are at a perfect 90-degree right angle
D) To drive metallic nails into hardwood
questions.answer: C) To check if adjacent edges are at a perfect 90-degree right angle

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The specific nutrient-rich, low-fiber food given to dairy cattle to significantly improve their daily milk yield and overall health is called ________.
Which of the following represents the crucial first step when conducting a systemic school water audit to manage resources efficiently?
options: A) Installing expensive new water filters
B) Identifying and physically mapping all water fixtures and potential leakage points
C) Painting all the overhead water tanks
D) Closing the school garden permanently
questions.answer: B) Identifying and physically mapping all water fixtures and potential leakage points

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The protective, hard outer layer of bamboo, which makes it highly resistant to water and decay, is naturally rich in a chemical compound called ________.

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Explain the vital function of an aerator pump in a basic hydroponic system setup. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An aerator pump continuously forces fresh air into the nutrient water reservoir. This oxygenates the solution, preventing plant roots from suffocating and ensuring healthy, rapid crop growth.

questions.question_text: Why is it absolutely essential to provide proper structural ventilation in shelters built for farm animals? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Proper ventilation ensures a continuous supply of fresh air, regulates internal temperature, and removes harmful ammonia gases accumulating from animal waste, preventing severe respiratory diseases among livestock.

questions.question_text: State two critical safety precautions a student must strictly follow while using a hand saw to cut bamboo. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A student must firmly clamp the bamboo piece to a stable workbench and deliberately keep their non-dominant hand safely away from the cutting line to prevent severe accidents.

questions.question_text: After conducting a comprehensive water audit, your team discovers that the school's washroom taps waste 50 liters of water daily due to slow dripping. Propose a practical, step-by-step action plan to resolve this wastage permanently. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, immediately shut off the main water supply valve connecting to the washrooms. Next, precisely document and report the specific leaking fixtures to maintenance staff. Finally, replace all worn-out rubber washers and install water-efficient aerators to drastically reduce future flow rates.
